summary: Eni S.p.A. disclosed in a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, its daily buyback execution on Euronext Milan dated 14 September 2026: 620,714 shares repurchased at a weighted average price of EUR 24.1657, totaling EUR 14,999,988.31, representing 0.02% of share capital. Purchases fall within the second tranche of a program approved at the 6 May 2026 Shareholders' Meeting, intended as additional shareholder remuneration alongside dividends. Cumulative acquisitions since 8 May 2026 total 69,995,483 shares, 2.31% of capital, for EUR 1,579,915,829.53; treasury holdings now 156,823,590 shares or 5.18%. Watch execution pace and treasury overhang.
